fusions.name: Gnawed Through
fusions.desc: Gnaws the target for 7 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 8 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Rattle the Grate
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3 tiles takes 12 damage and is stunned for 1 second.

fusions.name: Tin Can Hideout
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 6 seconds. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Cold Night Burrow
fusions.desc: At night, your armour rises by 12%. Your dodge chance rises by 5% at all times.
